articles.summary: KNOXVILLE, Tenn. (September 1, 2026) - Tennessee Athletics and First Horizon Bank (“First Horizon”) have announced a groundbreaking extension of their longstanding partnership. For 34 consecutive years, First Horizon has served as the Official Bank of the Vols, earning the trust and loyalty of the University of Tennessee community and its fans. articles.title: Tennessee Athletics and First Horizon Announce Historic Partnership Extension

articles.summary: First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN or "First Horizon") announced today that three of its bankers have been selected to participate in regional leadership programs across Southeast Louisiana: Tim Finn in the New Orleans Regional Leadership Institute (NORLI), Colin O'Flynn in the Jefferson Chamber of Commerce Leadership Jefferson program and Chris Tusa in Leadership St. Tammany. "These selections reflect the caliber of leaders we have at First Horizon and our commitment to being actively engaged in the communities we serve," said Jimmy Dunn, New Orleans Market President for First Horizon Bank. "Tim, Colin and Chris understand that leadership extends beyond the work we do for our clients, and we are proud to see them represent First Horizon throughout our region."
